svg.title: Three table formats represent historical state differently
svg.desc: Delta replays transaction actions, Iceberg follows snapshots and manifests, and Hudi assembles a timeline from file groups and slices.
svg.text: A format's history is metadata plus the files that history still has permission to reach.
_delta_log actions → reconstruct active file set → read version N
Checkpoint = skip ahead efficiently; it is not a time capsule for missing Parquet.
metadata JSON → snapshot → manifest list → manifests → data/delete files
Snapshot IDs are identities, not a friendly 1, 2, 3 counter.
completed instant → file group slices → merge base files and, for MOR, log files
Snapshot and read-optimized answers can differ after a delta commit.
Native history is not interchangeable syntax. It is three distinct state machines.
